mapper.select: select c.id, c.order_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, u.nick_name as user_nick_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, ru.nick_name as reply_nick_name from apply_comment c left join app_user u on u.id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join app_user ru on ru.id = c.reply_user_id and ru.del_flag = '0' where c.del_flag = '0' and c.order_id = #{orderId} order by c.create_time asc
